2026-08-17.summary:
## Rust Daily Dev Digest - 2026-08-17

### Performance & Optimization

*   Server performance improvements by culling bone hierarchies on building and boat planners, removing 17 gameobjects per planner.
*   Optimized conditional models in building blocks to only refresh when changed, preventing unnecessary destruction and recreation.
*   Rooms are now hidden only after being invisible for 5+ seconds to reduce churn and prevent disappearing during door animations.

### Content & Visuals

*   Added a white firework variant for the boomer explosive, including its icon and effects, to ensure pack icons are not misleading.
*   Updated loot crate visuals: fixed jungle primitive loot box gibs to use the proper material and fixed gibs for the basic crate and its colliders.
*   Applied visual conversions to various electrical components including CCTV cameras, windmills, water wheels, Tesla coils, and igniters.

### Gameplay & UI

*   Fixed an issue where players couldn't transfer water into a held water bucket via the UI.
*   The F1 menu category buttons are now sorted alphabetically by their translated labels.
*   Added a scroll fade/gradient to tabs in the demo UI and fixed alignment issues on non-keyframable rows.

### Technical & Experimental

*   Continued work on experimental unsafe scripting access, consolidating OS-specific calls and disabling multithreaded scripting on the client.
*   Fixed an issue where log messages from other threads were not appearing in the console/RCON.
*   Updated the SQLite clan system to prevent issues with stuck entries.
*   Experimental work on multiplayer editor features continues, including custom scenario dropdowns and performance logging fixes.
*   Added a test asset for per-face physics materials on a cube to analyze material boundary behavior.
